rows.label: Wait before the page shows on a phone
rows.why: Visitors see your page in 0.9 s instead of 14.9 s.
rows.impact: People leave a slow page before they reach your shop or your party booking.
rows.fine: Largest Contentful Paint, mean of 3 current pages against the 2 new pages that replace them; 0 of 3 within 2.5 s today, 2 of 2 rebuilt.

target.label: Good
target.source: Google’s Core Web Vitals mark for a good page load (web.dev).

rows.label: Speed on a phone, out of 100
rows.why: Most people look up a studio on their phone first.
rows.impact: This is their first impression of you.
rows.fine: Google Lighthouse performance score, mean of 3 current pages against the 2 new pages that replace them.

target.label: Good
target.source: The green “good” band of Google Lighthouse’s score (Chrome developer docs).

rows.label: Data a phone downloads per page
rows.why: Less to download means the page opens faster on a weak signal and costs visitors less data.
rows.fine: Total transfer size, mean of 3 current pages against the 2 new pages that replace them; 130 files a page today, 8 rebuilt.

rows.label: Usable by every visitor, out of 100
rows.why: An accessibility scanner found 48 problems on these pages today, and none on the new ones.
rows.fine: Google Lighthouse accessibility score on phones, mean of 3 current pages against the 2 new pages that replace them; axe-core WCAG 2.2 A and AA failures on desktop.

target.label: Good
target.source: The green “good” band of Google Lighthouse’s score (Chrome developer docs).

rows.label: Pages a visitor can zoom in on
rows.why: Some visitors need to pinch to enlarge the text before they can read it.
rows.fine: Pinching to enlarge text on a phone, which some visitors need to read it. Measured on 3 current pages against the 2 new pages that replace them.

target.label: Goal
target.source: No published benchmark; every page is the natural goal.

rows.label: Pages with a summary for Google results
rows.why: The short description Google may show under your name.
rows.fine: The short summary Google may show under the page’s title. Measured on 3 current pages against the 2 new pages that replace them.

target.label: Goal
target.source: No published benchmark; every page is the natural goal.

rows.label: Pages with your business details for Google
rows.why: Your name, address, phone and hours, in the form Google reads for its business panel.
rows.fine: Structured data: name, address, phone and hours, in the format Google reads. Measured on 3 current pages against the 2 new pages that replace them.

target.label: Goal
target.source: No published benchmark; every page is the natural goal.

rows.label: Your facts readable without running scripts
rows.why: Your current pages draw every word with a script, and many AI tools and crawlers do not run scripts.
rows.impact: They now see what a visitor sees: your hours, address and party packages.
rows.fine: Page text with JavaScript off. Share of 66 checks of 56 facts about the studio, on the same pages.

rows.label: Your facts AI assistants can read directly
rows.why: AI assistants answer questions about studios like yours, and can quote your details instead of guessing them.
rows.fine: Structured data (JSON-LD). Share of 66 checks of 56 facts about the studio, on the same pages.
